• *Source/Speaker:* India's Finance Minister, Nirmala Sitharaman
• *Announcement:* The Finance Minister identified fuel, fertilizer, and access to capital as key risks for India’s economy in 2027\. She also noted that market liquidity facilitates investor exits\.
• *Market Stance:* 🔴 BEARISH

📊 *CONFIDENCE LEVEL:* HIGH \(90\% \- Direct statement from India's Finance Minister\)

🎯 *INDIAN MARKET IMPACT:*
• *Vulnerable Sectors:* OGCs, Chemicals \(Agrochemicals\), Aviation, Infrastructure
• *Strategic Tailwinds:* None
• *Expected FII Sentiment:* Net Outflows \(Macro risks highlighted by the Finance Minister, combined with stated market liquidity for investor exits, may lead to cautious FII behavior and potential portfolio rebalancing away from India\.\)

💡 *TACTICAL ACTIONABLE OUTCOME:* Reduce exposure to OGCs, Agrochemicals, and Aviation\. Adopt a defensive posture in capital\-intensive sectors like Infrastructure until economic risk clarity improves\.
